term.name: regular_token
term.definition: A nonterminal of an ixml grammar whose language is regular (characters, character sets, repetitions and such nonterminals, no recursion but a repetition's) and whose XML is its text or nothing: its uses inside are hidden, it has no insertions, and its terminals are all kept or all hidden. Compiled once with the grammar into a token automaton; the Earley parser reads it in one step and completes it at each end the lookahead allows ()
